performance.environmentNote: Unfocused or occluded browser windows were capped near 30 Hz. With a dedicated Chromium window brought to the foreground, focus emulation enabled, and the page lifecycle set to active, four steady 47/138 transitions and three 200/500 runs were stable below 12 ms p95. The pass is scoped to this focused foreground runtime.

limitations: The strict independent visual review scores the revised candidate 85.5/100, with every dimension at least 3/5. Final visual acceptance by the user is still required for the later `passed` state.

Browser media emulation confirms reduced motion: the media query is true, CSS animations are none, the camera is settled immediately and remains unchanged after 900 ms. The actual macOS accessibility preference was not changed, so the system-level hard blocker remains `not_run`.

Unfocused browser tabs and windows are capped near 30 Hz in this environment. Three focused 200/500 runs produced 8.3–8.4 ms medians and 9.1–9.6 ms p95 values with all 500 edges drawn; results apply only to this Mac, focused runtime and synthetic graph sizes.
The current API still does not expose an authoritative graph-as-of or cursor projection, so the evolution view remains a single-object published-version comparison rather than whole-network history.
All data are the isolated synthetic engineering fixture. This review does not establish real semantic quality, reader comprehension, business effect, deployment, or user visual acceptance.
